title: Design System: The Good Opal Co

label.purpose: Footer column and facet heads only.

shadows.name: floating
shadows.purpose: Drawer, dialogs and suggestion lists only. Page sections are flat.

motion.name: gallery
motion.purpose: Photo scale, piece morph and torch fade.

motion.name: piece-morph
motion.purpose: Card photo to product gallery view transition.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Dark ink action with light text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 22px; border: 1px solid #1C1813; border-radius: 2px; background: #1C1813; color: #F5F2EC; font: 500 15px 'Schibsted Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 200ms, border-color 200ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #3A332B; border-color: #3A332B; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7A5C24; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 22px; border: 1px solid rgba(28,24,19,.24); border-radius: 2px; background: transparent; color: #1C1813; font: 500 15px 'Schibsted Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 200ms; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: #1C1813; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7A5C24; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Product Card
components.description: Photo on a plinth, italic name, price right, one meta line.
components.html: Boulder opal pendant$420Boulder · Queensland · 4.2 ct
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; color: #1C1813; text-decoration: none; } .ds-ph { aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; background: #EBE6DD; } .ds-cap { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: 2px 12px; padding-top: 10px; } .ds-nm { font: italic 400 15px 'Bodoni Moda', serif; } .ds-pr { font: 500 14px 'Schibsted Grotesk', sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-mt { grid-column: 1 / -1; font-size: 12.5px; color: #544C42; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Plain field with a hairline outline and a brass focus ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; font: 400 15px 'Schibsted Grotesk', sans-serif; color: #1C1813; } .ds-field span { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-field input { height: 44px; border: 1px solid rgba(28,24,19,.24); border-radius: 2px; background: transparent; padding: 0 12px; font: inherit; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7A5C24; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Mast link; the current page gets a brass underline.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { padding: 6px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid transparent; color: #544C42; font: 400 13.5px 'Schibsted Grotesk', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .01em; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link[aria-current=page] { color: #1C1813; } .ds-nav-link[aria-current=page] { border-bottom-color: #7A5C24; }

narrative.overview: A small, well-lit gallery: warm paper walls, stones on plinths, quiet labels, nothing between the visitor and the opal. Pages are dense; pieces start in the first screen.
keyCharacteristics: Photographs on plinths in tight grids with small captions.
Warm off-white page, dark ink text, one brass accent.
Bodoni Moda for names and headings, Schibsted Grotesk for everything else.
Hairline rules instead of cards and shadows.
A soft pointer torch on the wall and photos that carry across pages.

rules.name: The Untouched Stone Rule
rules.body: No CSS filters, tints, blend modes, gradients, scrims or overlays on product or stone photos.

rules.name: The One Colour Rule
rules.body: The opal supplies the colour. No decorative gradients, glows or tinted bands.

rules.name: Flat Pages
rules.body: Hairlines separate content; shadows only on floating layers.

dos: Start pages with content: pieces or the task in the first screen.
Keep price, stock, shipping, returns and origin close to the buy action.
Honour prefers-reduced-motion: no view transitions, no torch movement.
donts: Don't put filters, tints, gradients or overlays on stone photos.
Don't add tall hero bands, eyebrows or decorative dividers.
Don't nest cards or shadow flat page sections.
Don't use React Context as the cart source of truth.
